## Biographical Information

(1802/3-1884)

father of Edith Jacob, Rector of Crawley and Archdeacon of Winchester

Daughter of the Venerable Canon Philip Jacob (1802/3-1884), rector from 1831 of Crawley with Hunton, north-west of Winchester, and canon and (from 1860) Archdeacon of Winchester,
